inputs.goal: review the Acme MSA under our standard enterprise risk posture

redline.intake.summary: Acme MSA presents moderate risk exposure across multiple clauses. Termination for convenience clause allows either party to end agreement with minimal penalty, creating potential operational disruption risk. Data protection and privacy clause requires strengthening to meet enterprise security standards. Intellectual property ownership clause needs clarification on usage rights and ownership transfer mechanisms. Indemnification and liability limitation clause provides insufficient protection against third-party claims. Compliance with applicable laws clause lacks specific regulatory adherence requirements. Overall risk posture rated as moderate-high, requiring additional contractual safeguards before proceeding.

playbook_positions.position: Standard termination for convenience with 30-day notice required, business accepts 30-day window as acceptable risk threshold
Enterprise data protection standard requires encryption at rest and in transit, business accepts additional security controls as necessary to meet compliance requirements
IP ownership must be clearly defined with transfer mechanisms, business accepts standard IP ownership model with explicit licensing terms
Liability limitation capped at contract value, business accepts this as baseline but requires additional indemnification for third-party claims
General compliance clause acceptable, business requires specific regulatory adherence requirements to be added to contract

redline.review.output: All redlines properly cite their corresponding playbook positions and clearly identify the risk created by the original language. Each redline aligns with the enterprise risk posture and provides necessary contractual safeguards. No stylistic edits without playbook references are present.
